[[File:Guwatudde2- 21Dec18.jpg|thumb|Guwatudde David]]
'''Prof David Guwatudde''' is a Ugandan academic and researcher. He is currently a professor of Epidemiology and Biostatistics in the Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics at the School of Public Health, [[Makerere University College of Health Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-09-23 |title=Dr. David Guwatudde |url=https://sph.mak.ac.ug/about-us/personnel/dr-david-guwatudde |access-date=2022-05-30 |website=School of Public Health |language=en |archive-date=2021-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210918094117/https://sph.mak.ac.ug/about-us/personnel/dr-david-guwatudde }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=David Guwatudde - AD Scientific Index 2022 |url=https://www.adscientificindex.com/scientist.php?id=4347525 |access-date=2022-05-30 |website=www.adscientificindex.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-05-11 |title=New research warns of Non communicable disease crisis in waiting |url=https://www.independent.co.ug/new-research-warns-of-non-communicable-disease-crisis-in-waiting/ |access-date=2022-05-30 |website=The Independent Uganda |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Background and education ==
He obtained his Msc in statistics from the [[University of Southampton]], UK, and his PhD from the [[Case Western Reserve University]], Cleveland, Ohio, USA.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-09-23 |title=Dr. David Guwatudde |url=https://sph.mak.ac.ug/about-us/personnel/dr-david-guwatudde |access-date=2022-05-30 |website=School of Public Health |language=en |archive-date=2021-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210918094117/https://sph.mak.ac.ug/about-us/personnel/dr-david-guwatudde }}</ref>

== Research ==
He is a researcher whose areas of expertise include epidemiology of hypertension, epidemiology of diabetes, evaluation of effectiveness of interventions for the prevention, management and control of high burden diseases, especially non-communicable diseases, and [[capacity building]] through tertiary training.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Profiles |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=search_authors&hl=en&mauthors=label:evaluation_of_interventions_for_management_and_control_of_hypertension_and_diabetes |access-date=2022-05-30 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> His works have been highly used with 4,361 citations, h-index of 34 and i-10 index of 41.<ref>{{Cite web |title=David Guwatudde |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=GvhaIXwAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2022-05-30 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> Some of his highly cited works include;
